general.title: General
general.description: Configure instance-wide preferences including language, log display, keyboard shortcuts, backup retention, and data sharing.
general.localTrustedDescription: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
general.publicDescription: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
general.privateDescription: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
general.censorUsernameDescription: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
general.keyboardShortcutsDescription: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating issues or toggling panels. This is off by default.
general.backupRetentionDescription: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
general.feedbackSharingDescription: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
general.feedbackPromptNotice: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
general.doNotAllowDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
general.devResetHint: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the feedbackDataSharingPreference key from the instance_settings.general JSON row for this instance, or set it back to "prompt". Unset and "prompt" both mean no default has been chosen yet.
